title: Toll Holdings Limited - completed acquisition of assets of Concord Park Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Toll acquired the assets of Concord Park Ltd. Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC findings of 10 June 2010 removed after the acquisition was completed.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Toll Holdings Limited has acquired the assets of Concord Park Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the acquisition in the context of a national market for the supply of freight forwarding and line haul services by road for general freight.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant market for the following reasons: - there remain a number of significant providers of integrated freight forwarding and line haul services which offer comparable services to the merged firm; - there are also a high number of second-tier and smaller transport operators which are likely to be able to expand relatively quickly in response to a price increase by the merged firm; and - the acquisition represents a small incremental increase in Toll Limited's share of sales in the relevant market.
